task: Create original Figma website template from Sportz sports streaming reference

styleDNA.typographyBehavior: Large high-contrast dark hero type, compact metadata labels, uppercase status chips, and dense sports UI hierarchy.
styleDNA.layoutRhythm: Cinematic opening, signal strip, event-row density, replay editorial pause, analytics proof, pricing conversion, and command closure.
styleDNA.spacingDensity: Dense broadcast spacing with tight console gutters, 72-96px section cadence, and compact row systems.
styleDNA.colorBehavior: Dark surfaces carry immersion while red action and warm proof accents create urgency.
styleDNA.imageDirection: Streaming, replay, chart, and fan-room zones are represented as editable source placeholders.
styleDNA.shapeLanguage: Rounded console panels, inset event rows, pill status chips, and compact sports cards.
styleDNA.effectLanguage: Panel shadows, low-contrast borders, red focus outlines, and subtle proof highlights.
styleDNA.premiumSignal: Feels like a paid sports-streaming product template because it includes live, schedule, replay, proof, fan, pricing, FAQ, CTA, and DS coverage.

referenceStandard.observedSectionCountRange: Sports streaming references require a full homepage journey; 9-12 sections are commercially appropriate.
referenceStandard.sectionRoleEvidence: The reference suggests live content discovery, event scheduling, category browsing, proof, articles, pricing, and support.
referenceStandard.layoutShapeInventory: Dark hero, stream modules, row ledgers, card grids, content bands, FAQ stack, and footer closure.
referenceStandard.colorRoleInventory: Reference uses dark immersion plus red action; the rebuild remaps this into graphite, oxblood, red action, amber proof, and muted stone copy.
referenceStandard.effectGradientInventory: Depth comes from dark surfaces, borders, and action accents rather than copied gradient or imagery.
referenceStandard.marketplaceCompletenessClues: A sellable streaming template needs schedule, replay, plan, support, source placeholders, and a design-system board.
referenceStandard.remixPlan: Keep the commercial logic of a sports streaming homepage but rebuild hero grammar, cards, proof modules, pricing, and section rhythm as KineticCast.

designIntentLock.targetBuyer: Marketplace buyer building sports streaming, club media, or event broadcast websites.
designIntentLock.useCase: Complete homepage source with sections, placeholder media, and a separate design-system board.
designIntentLock.marketplaceValue: Gives buyers a rich streaming product flow instead of a thin landing page.
designIntentLock.primaryGoal: Make sports viewers understand live access, schedules, replays, social viewing, and pricing quickly.

visualGrammar.gridBehavior: 12-column dark container with asymmetric hero, row ledgers, grids, and proof bands.
visualGrammar.spacingCadence: Dense but controlled vertical rhythm that supports scan-heavy sports content.
visualGrammar.typeHierarchy: Hero-scale display, compact labels, mid-scale card titles, and legible dark-mode body copy.
visualGrammar.surfaceDepth: Nested console panels, raised cards, inset rows, and red outline focus states.
visualGrammar.colorRoles: Graphite base, oxblood panels, red action, amber proof, muted copy, and dark borders.
visualGrammar.imageTreatment: Media appears as stream, replay, chart, and fan placeholders with line hints.
visualGrammar.effectLogic: Effects reinforce live broadcast urgency and hierarchy, not decoration.
visualGrammar.componentRhythm: Event rows and dense cards alternate with editorial and proof pauses.

referenceBoundary.allowedToLearn: Product category, sports streaming density, live-event section logic, dark urgency, and paid-template completeness.
referenceBoundary.forbiddenToCopy: Do not copy exact layout, color palette, section order, hero grammar, component scaffold, imagery, logo, or reference card cadence.

colorRoleRemapping.referenceDominantColorIdentity: dark sports streaming energy with red action cues
colorRoleRemapping.referenceColorRoles: dark immersion, red action, white copy, and sports media contrast
colorRoleRemapping.remappedPaletteDirection: graphite broadcast base with oxblood panels, amber proof cue, and action red reserved for live conversion
colorRoleRemapping.newAccentIdentity: warm amber proof and muted stone support copy separate this from the reference's direct red-only emphasis
colorRoleRemapping.preservedEmotionalRole: Urgency, live access, and high-stakes sports energy are preserved.
colorRoleRemapping.avoidedExactHues: The palette avoids direct color sampling from the reference and builds a new role map.
colorRoleRemapping.contrastHierarchyBehavior: Red is limited to key actions while surfaces and text control the rest of the hierarchy.

visualMoodReinterpretation.referenceMood: Dark streaming product with energetic sports urgency.
visualMoodReinterpretation.reinterpretedMood: Broadcast command center for live matches and replay control.
visualMoodReinterpretation.changedComposition: The design uses a command console and event ledger rather than the reference's exact preview composition.
visualMoodReinterpretation.changedHierarchy: Schedule, replay, fan room, and pricing get stronger buyer-journey roles.
visualMoodReinterpretation.changedAssetTreatment: All media becomes editable placeholder zones with purpose labels.
visualMoodReinterpretation.changedDepthEffect: Depth is created through console surfaces and borders rather than copying reference decoration.

structuralReconfiguration.referenceStructurePattern: Sports streaming homepage with live content, category modules, support blocks, and conversion.
structuralReconfiguration.newStructurePattern: Command-center homepage with 12 sections: hero, signal, live room, discovery, schedule, replay, analytics, fan, pricing, FAQ, CTA, footer.
structuralReconfiguration.heroGrammarChange: Hero becomes a left manifesto plus right live stream console and metrics instead of a copied reference hero.
structuralReconfiguration.sectionOrderChange: Schedule, replay, analytics, fan rooms, and pricing are sequenced as a sports decision journey.
structuralReconfiguration.gridSystemChange: Uses console rows, ledgers, and dense proof bands instead of a universal card grid.
structuralReconfiguration.ctaFlowChange: CTAs escalate from watch-now to pass pricing to final broadcast command.
structuralReconfiguration.componentLayoutChange: Components are rebuilt as stream consoles, event rows, replay cards, analytics panels, fan cards, and pass cards.

patternDivergence.divergenceFromReference: Original naming, section sequence, card anatomy, proof strategy, and placeholder treatment.
patternDivergence.heroDivergence: Command-center console grammar replaces any direct reference hero arrangement.
patternDivergence.sectionRhythmDivergence: Dense sports rows and proof bands create a distinct rhythm from the reference image.
patternDivergence.visualLanguageDivergence: Graphite, oxblood, red, and amber role system creates a new sports identity.
patternDivergence.componentCadenceDivergence: Event rows, replay studio, analytics proof, and fan rooms change the repeated-module cadence.

sectionLogic.roleOfEachSection: Hero establishes live access; signal rail builds proof; arena and discovery sell content breadth; schedule and replay handle decision detail; analytics and fan rooms add trust; pricing, FAQ, CTA, and footer close conversion.
sectionLogic.buyerJourneyFlow: Immediate excitement, content confidence, schedule proof, replay value, social proof, price decision, objection handling, and final action.
sectionLogic.fillerSectionsRemoved: No generic feature strip or filler CTA; every section maps to sports-streaming buyer utility.
sectionLogic.productFamilyDepthStandard: Full sports streaming marketplace templates need live events, schedules, replays, proof, pricing, and support, so 12 sections are justified.

marketplaceReadiness.sectionDepth: 12 meaningful homepage sections with product-specific modules.
marketplaceReadiness.premiumSignal: Dark command-center presentation, dense sports modules, and design-system documentation.
marketplaceReadiness.editability: Named Figma sections, editable text, source placeholders, and auto-layout modules.
marketplaceReadiness.sourceReadiness: Separate design-system board, placeholder policy, token receipt, and visual screenshots are present.
marketplaceReadiness.previewValue: Pack overview and homepage screenshot communicate the product clearly to buyers.
marketplaceReadiness.commercialUsefulness: Useful for streaming apps, club media, sports networks, and event broadcast services.
marketplaceReadiness.nonGenericProof: Contains schedule ledger, replay studio, fan room, analytics proof, and sports-specific pass pricing.
